name: Anarlog
summary: Local, open-source AI meeting notepad (formerly Hyprnote) that stays off the call, keeps data on your device, and offers an optional Pro plan.
description: Local, open-source AI meeting notepad (formerly Hyprnote) that stays off the call, keeps data on your device, and offers an optional Pro plan.
features: Bot-free, local-first meeting notepad: notes, transcripts and recordings stay on your device by default
Open source, with on-device models or your own API keys, plus a local API, CLI, MCP and webhooks
Optional Pro: cloud transcription and LLM, system-wide dictation, sync, E2EE and team sharing
Desktop app for Mac, Windows (beta) and Linux (beta); built-in on-device transcription needs supported Apple Silicon
